utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — those are still the big needs. If you spot any extras, just bring them by and I’ll pass along anything else I hear.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I really appreciate it. I’ll let you know if I hear of anything else needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s right — Saturday at 10:00 at the community center side entrance. I’ll send the final tool list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
